dt_sweep.rationale: Static analysis — no time discretization. Marked stable as a sentinel value; not a temporal convergence claim.

mesh_sweep.rationale: 32 C3D20 elements, 8 through-wall. Worst-case relative error vs Lame's analytical solution: σ_r ≤ 1.16%, σ_θ ≤ 0.14%, σ_z ≤ 0.20%, vM ≤ 0.20%. All comfortably below the 5% engineering tolerance applied for Tier 1 candidate scoping.
